name: smwgraphics-banjo-kazooie-captain-blubber
title: Banjo-Kazooie - Captain Blubber
description:
The famous Captain Blubber from Banjo-Kazooie, now even closer to your SMW Hack. A perfect fit for pirate-themed levels or even hacks. This skin replaces the Mega Mole. You can also use it with wye's NPC sprite , if you want too. Just make sure to change its palette.

Credits should go to No Body The Dragon.
